name: Mira
explanation: A young woman who knows the harbour by heart and never tires of the horizon.
content: Mira is the last of one of the town's oldest families. She believes she can speak with the sea; perhaps she is simply the one who listens to it best.

stories.title: The Last Keeper of the Lighthouse
stories.explanation: For years the lighthouse burned the same light — until one night it went out on its own.

stories.title: The Glass Garden
stories.explanation: Behind Bahar's clock shop lies a garden no one knows of — made of glass and of time.
